act.note: rg检索act目录及工作区未发现ACT/DETRVAE已生成SVG/PNG/semantic IR；如有另一路径需要补充盘点，不能把源码类的存在算为图中展开。

definitions.explicitly_expanded_composite: a rendered group has separately rendered source-bound child nodes in the same view
definitions.explicit_atomic_operator: a separately drawn primitive/operator call; its numerical/library kernel is not claimed to be expanded
definitions.folded_composite: source IR children exist but the group currently renders as one glyph
definitions.source_composite_summarized_in_one_glyph: compound source behavior represented by one glyph plus annotations, without a child graph
definitions.opaque_runtime_boundary: IR explicitly marks unprovided runtime implementation (nn.GRU or nn.LSTM here)
definitions.not_separately_rendered: node survives in semantic IR but has no own box in that view; inspect nearest rendered ancestor
definitions.folded_inline_annotation: IR node folded into parent/neighbor glyph text by the layout

caveats: IR kind labels are renderer categories, not a count of mathematically distinct module families.
Same color/shape does not imply same algorithm or shared parameters.
Folded repeated instances do not make a family new when a representative instance is already expanded.
The classification comes from artifact nodes/layout membership and source-review docs, not fresh pixel inspection of all90 SVGs.
The suggestions bind only to frozen directory entries/paths; an external listing is not yet a fetched and validated module implementation.
